why: Restores the shipped wording for a paused PRACTICE session, keeping the arm and its condition so nothing about the structure reads as wrong. That is the whole defect issue #323's contextual pause exit removes: "Quit to Title" describes suspending a run, and a practice board is not one -- loop.ts's session identity keeps it from reading or writing the campaign run at all. The button is visible and does exactly the same thing either way, so only a copy assertion driven by a practice STATUS can see this; every campaign and versus assertion in the file stays green. Re-anchored for issue #261: the practice arm's tail is now the versus arm rather than the generic fallback, so the find string carries the following condition to stay unique.
